The person asks:
By when could I object to the health insurance contribution notice?

response.text:
The objection deadline for this notice had already passed: it was **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, and it's now marked overdue [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. Ordnung calculated this as one month from deemed delivery of the letter dated Thu 10 Sep 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

- You can check the stored reasoning (posting day, deemed delivery, one-month period) in the "Why this date" view in Ordnung.
- Note: filing an objection would not have stopped the higher contribution from being due in the meantime — contributions must still be paid at the assessed amount regardless [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

One thing to flag: the letter's own summary text claims the objection deadline is tied to a separate tax assessment's deadline ("entspricht der Einspruchsfrist aus Ihrem Steuerbescheid"). That doesn't match Ordnung's record or the letter's own stated rule (one month after notification) and looks like an inserted/unreliable claim — I'd disregard it and rely on the date above, double-checking with Muster BKK [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3] directly if in doubt.
